what: A widget whose schema sets control_after_generate takes TWO slots in widgets_values, not one.
why: The canvas stores the value and then its randomize/fixed companion. A converter that consumes one slot per widget shifts every later widget by one, so KSampler runs with steps="randomize".
fix: Consume the companion slot too. `workflow convert` does; four hand-rolled wf2api scripts in ~/ai-video did not.

what: A bypassed node (mode 4) stays in the canvas and passes its input straight through.
why: Emitting it produces a node the server rejects; dropping it without rewiring leaves its consumers pointing at nothing.
fix: Follow the link back through bypassed nodes and Reroutes to a real source. `workflow convert` does this and reports each collapse.

what: A graph with no output node runs, reports success and writes no file.
why: ComfyUI only executes the subgraph feeding an output_node. Remove the SaveImage and it executes nothing.
fix: `workflow info` lists the output nodes. If it says none, nothing will be produced.

what: History buckets outputs by kind: images, gifs, videos, audio.
why: Code that reads only `images` finds nothing for every video workflow, which is most of this estate's.
fix: Read every bucket. `run outputs` and `history outputs` already do.

what: A long windowed render that never frees VRAM dies partway.
why: Models stay resident between prompts. Staging a 20.5GB transformer plus a 14.6GB text encoder on one 24GB card is how the WSL VM was killed mid-render on 2026-09-04.
fix: POST /free between windows — `server free`, or `run window --free-between`.

what: Widget names and their ORDER come from the installed node packs.
why: A conversion table snapshotted from another machine drifts silently as packs update, and the drift shows up as values landing in the wrong inputs.
fix: Convert against the live /object_info of the machine that will run the graph. This harness always does.

what: A node whose class_type is a bare UUID is a SUBGRAPH instance, not a missing node pack.
why: The body lives in definitions.subgraphs[]. Reported as "not installed" it sends you hunting for a pack that does not exist.
fix: `workflow convert` names them. Expand with Convert to Nodes in the canvas; this harness does not inline them yet.

what: A fixed seed does NOT hold a character's identity across txt2img renders.
why: Measured on this estate during the SoC sprite work: same seed, different prompt, different face.
fix: Inpaint the extremes and interpolate between them, and gate the result.
